groups.defect: The lazy `translate` loads only `config.locale`, and only ApplicationController#set_locale loads the fallback chain (site default and :en). So in jobs, mailers, rake tasks and the console, fallback lookups miss, and the 'translation missing' result is frozen into the LRU cache. Separately, the cache key leaves out SiteSetting.default_locale, so cached fallback text goes stale after the default locale changes.

answer.reasoning:
s_35d3c9d2, s_a0b43d2d, s_c94570f5, s_d02ab584 and s_6a01472a all report the same defect: fallback locales are loaded only in the controller hook, while `translate` lazy-loads only config.locale. Outside requests, fallbacks therefore miss, and in most of these reports the miss gets cached. Each one proposes the same fix: load the fallback chain inside `translate`.

s_6a01472a also reports, as its own problem, that the cache key leaves out SiteSetting.default_locale, so cached fallback text goes stale after the default locale changes. That is exactly the one defect s_e15dc8b6 reports. Under the overlap rule, that shared defect pulls s_e15dc8b6 into the group.

The members point at two files (translate_accelerator.rb and config/initializers/i18n.rb), so the kind is cross_location. The merged comment has to keep both defects (missing fallback loading and the stale cache key), so needsUnifiedComment is true. Both judges agree on the membership; they differ only on the kind.
